name: damez-loan
description: Loan Origination and Recovery Banking Suite

scripts.build: npm run build -w @damez/shared && npm run build -w @damez/api && npm run build -w @damez/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @damez/api" "npm run dev -w @damez/web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
